traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.text: The lizardfolk can hold its breath for 15 minutes.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The lizardfolk makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Heavy Club
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage.
